trigger.description: The workspace discovery lists exist but cannot be honoured, so no peer is probed. load_node_key_list spells every benign case Ok(empty) -- absent file, non-regular path, NotFound, no node_keys key -- so an error here always means an operator supplied a list that could not be read, parsed or bounded. Probing with an empty denylist would contact exactly the peers the workspace denies, which is the fail-open bd-xwzeh closed.
